name: Treder TrustProof for WooCommerce
author: Ben Treder

sections.description:
This plugin is not affiliated with WooCommerce or Automattic. WooCommerce is a trademark of Automattic Inc.

Treder TrustProof for WooCommerce helps WooCommerce store owners find missing trust basics and display a simple reassurance box on product, cart, and checkout pages.

Free features include:

  • Store Trust Score out of 100
  • WooCommerce-aware trust checklist
  • Business identity and mailing location fields
  • Support email and phone fields
  • Product page trust box
  • Cart page trust box
  • Checkout reassurance box
  • Shortcode: [treder_trustproof_box]
  • Premium-ready architecture for the paid add-on

This plugin is not a legal service and does not provide legal advice. It gives practical storefront trust reminders and display tools.

Support: ben@bentreder.com
Built by Ben Treder, WordPress.org username bdtreder.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > TrustProof.
  5. Fill in your business and trust message settings.
sections.faq:
Does this replace legal pages?

No. This plugin does not provide legal advice and does not replace privacy, terms, refund, shipping, or compliance pages.

Where does the trust box show?

You can show it on product pages, cart pages, checkout pages, or anywhere using the shortcode:

[treder_trustproof_box]

Is there a Premium version?

Yes. Treder TrustProof for WooCommerce Premium is a separate paid add-on with report exports, premium badge styles, business detail display, and advanced storefront proof tools.
